## Independence and proportionality

- [ ] Device behavior was derived independently of the production implementation.
- [ ] Unsupported model input is distinguishable from a device response.
- [ ] The model remains quiescent between explicit ordered inputs.
- [ ] Harness time, environmental truth, topology, and orchestration remain outside the device.
- [ ] Packaging is a local choice rather than a claimed shared requirement.
- [ ] Additional code, documents, scripts, adapters, and tests have current value proportional to their burden.
- [ ] No shared framework or coordinator API is introduced without a current consumer or repeated semantic need.
